column.name: report_sql
column.value: WITH gl_fs_map AS ( WITH RECURSIVE gl_tree AS ( SELECT a.id, a.gl_code, a.name, a.parent_id, a.id AS fs_caption_id FROM acc_gl_account a WHERE a.gl_code LIKE 'FSCA%' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.gl_code, c.name, c.parent_id, p.fs_caption_id FROM acc_gl_account c JOIN gl_tree p ON c.parent_id = p.id ) SELECT t.id AS gl_account_id, t.gl_code, t.name, f.gl_code AS fs_caption_code, f.name AS fs_caption_name FROM gl_tree t JOIN acc_gl_account f ON f.id = t.fs_caption_id WHERE t.gl_code NOT LIKE 'FSCA%' ) SELECT fullouterjoinresult.glcode, fullouterjoinresult.name, fullouterjoinresult.description, m.fs_caption_code AS "FS Caption Code", m.fs_caption_name AS "FS Caption Name", fullouterjoinresult.debit, fullouterjoinresult.credit FROM ( select debits.glcode as "glcode", debits.name as "name", debits.description, debits.type, (case when debits.type = 1 or debits.type = 5 then coalesce(debits.debitamount, 0) - coalesce(credits.creditamount, 0) else null end) as "debit", (case when debits.type = 4 or debits.type = 3 or debits.type = 2 then coalesce(credits.creditamount, 0) - coalesce(debits.debitamount, 0) else null end) as "credit" from ( select acc_gl_account.gl_code as "glcode", name, acc_gl_account.description, sum(amount) as "debitamount", acc_gl_account.classification_enum as "type" from acc_gl_journal_entry, acc_gl_account where acc_gl_account.id = acc_gl_journal_entry.account_id and acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum = 2 and acc_gl_journal_entry.entry_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (acc_gl_journal_entry.office_id = ${officeId} or ${officeId} = 1) group by glcode, acc_gl_account.name, acc_gl_account.classification_enum, acc_gl_account.description order by glcode ) debits left outer join ( select acc_gl_account.gl_code as "glcode", name as "name", acc_gl_account.description, sum(amount) as "creditamount", acc_gl_account.classification_enum as "type" from acc_gl_journal_entry, acc_gl_account where acc_gl_account.id = acc_gl_journal_entry.account_id and acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum = 1 and acc_gl_journal_entry.entry_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (acc_gl_journal_entry.office_id = ${officeId} or ${officeId} = 1) group by glcode, acc_gl_account.classification_enum, acc_gl_account.name, acc_gl_account.description order by glcode ) credits on debits.glcode = credits.glcode union select credits.glcode as "glcode", credits.name as "name", credits.description, credits.type, (case when credits.type = 1 or credits.type = 5 then coalesce(debits.debitamount, 0) - coalesce(credits.creditamount, 0) else null end) as "debit", (case when credits.type = 4 or credits.type = 3 or credits.type = 2 then coalesce(credits.creditamount, 0) - coalesce(debits.debitamount, 0) else null end) as "credit" from ( select acc_gl_account.gl_code as "glcode", name, acc_gl_account.description, sum(amount) as "debitamount", acc_gl_account.classification_enum as "type" from acc_gl_journal_entry, acc_gl_account where acc_gl_account.id = acc_gl_journal_entry.account_id and acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum = 2 and acc_gl_journal_entry.entry_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (acc_gl_journal_entry.office_id = '${officeId}' or '${officeId}' = 1) group by glcode, acc_gl_account.name, acc_gl_account.classification_enum, acc_gl_account.description order by glcode ) debits right outer join ( select acc_gl_account.gl_code as "glcode", name as "name", acc_gl_account.description, sum(amount) as "creditamount", acc_gl_account.classification_enum as "type" from acc_gl_journal_entry, acc_gl_account where acc_gl_account.id = acc_gl_journal_entry.account_id and acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum = 1 and acc_gl_journal_entry.entry_date between '${startDate}' and '${endDate}' and (acc_gl_journal_entry.office_id = ${officeId} or ${officeId} = 1) group by glcode, acc_gl_account.name, acc_gl_account.classification_enum, acc_gl_account.description order by glcode ) credits on debits.glcode = credits.glcode ) as fullouterjoinresult left join gl_fs_map m on m.gl_code = fullouterjoinresult.glcode order by glcode
